title: WWE RAW Results, Highlights and Key Moments for May 11, 2026
summary: Tonight’s WWE RAW airing May 11, 2026, promises an action-packed night live from the Food City Center in Knoxville, Tennessee. The post-WWE Backlash show sees “The Samoan Werewolf” Jacob Fatu take part in a Roman Reigns Acknowledgment Ceremony. Plus, “The Ruler” Oba Femi will have an open challenge. The show kicks off at 8:00 PM ET on Netflix and is available for international fans on streaming platforms like Netflix. Ringside News will provide live, match-by-match updates and highlights throughout the night. Stay tuned to this page, refresh for the latest results as the action unfolds, and join the conversation in the comments below! Matches & Key Moments Scheduled for WWE RAW on May 11, 2026 WWE RAW Results (5/11/26): Live Match Updates and Highlights The show opens up with a video package recapping this past Saturday’s WWE Backlash PLE. Michael Cole and Corey Graves then welcomes us to the show as we see the arrivals of Paige, Brie Bella, Oba Femi, IYO SKY, The Street Profits and Joe Hendry. We then see a vehicle arrive at the building and Roman Reigns is here. RAW General Manager Adam Pearce says Backlash was too much for Fatu. He then says Fatu does not deserve to be here tonight and maybe not anymore after what he did on Saturday night. Roman then says he wants to know why his title is not in his hands. Pearce then calls for the belt. Roman then asks Pearce if he is going to fire him. He then says Jacob hasn’t acknowledged him yet. Roman then asks who brought him in and Pearce says it was Roman. Roman then says he will take him out. The Vision’s music then hits and they make their way down to the ring. Paul Heyman then grabs a mic and introduces himself. Heyman then says they are supposed to open the show on a high note. Heyman then says they are coming from the inbred capital of Eastern Tennessee. Heyman then says the audience is unappreciative. Heyman then says they did get to appreciate Bron Breakker on Saturday. Heyman then asks who is not ready now. Heyman then says the answer to that question is Seth Rollins. Heyman then says on Saturday night, Seth was not ready for the physical onslaught of Bron Breakker. Heyman then says a year ago, Seth was not ready for his wisdom. Heyman then says Seth will never be ready to have a vision or victory over any of them. Heyman then says let’s expunge Seth from the history of the group. Heyman then says there will not be a reason to mention Seth’s name. Heyman then says he wants to talk about the tag champions. Heyman then asks Austin to air his many grievances. Austin then says they have Bron back, so they have a six man tonight. That then brings him to The Street Profits. He then says they put their nose in their business because they want the tag titles. He then says they need the tag titles. He then says it is because Bianca can’t pay the bills any more. He then says what about Joe Hendry. The Street Profits’ music then hits and they make their way down to the ring. Montez then mentions Rocky Top and he says Theory has a point. He then says it is because his wife can’t take care of bills. He then says since she is taking care of the baby they will whoop their asses all over Knoxville. He then says you think it is about you. He then says when they came back to RAW, they had one goal in mind. He then says the Tag Titles. He then says they still want the smoke. Logan then says he will say something nice. He then says The Street Profits are a legendary tag team, but you will find out they are old news. He then says the only notable thing you have done in the last six months is throw a baby shower. He then says your girl is better than you. He then says they are ready any time, anywhere. He then says they were born ready. Joe Hendry then makes his way to ringside to sing his Logan Paul song. 6-Man Tag Team Match: The Street Profits (Montez Ford and Angelo Dawkins) and Joe Hendry vs. The Vision (“The Unpredictable Badass” Bron Breakker and WWE World Tag Team Champions “The Maverick” Logan Paul and Austin Theory) The match starts off with Theory and Ford and they lock up. Theory then cinches in a side head lock and he hits a shoulder tackle. They then lock up again and Ford cinches in a side head lock. Ford then floats over and Ford hits a shoulder tackle. Ford then hits a standing moonsault for a near fall. Logan then comes in and the referee stops him. Theory then hits a forearm to Joe on the apron and Ford sends Theory into the corner. Dawkins then tags in and Dawkins hits a flying corkscrew elbow. Dawkins then hits a twisting splash into the corner followed by an enzuigiri for a near fall. Logan then tags in and he punches Dawkins. Logan then hits a knee to the midsection and an Irish whip. Logan then misses a splash into the corner when Dawkins moves. Ford then tags in and he hits a drop kick. Bron then comes in and he hits a clothesline. Bron then hits a suplex and he gets a near fall. Bron then sends Ford into the turnbuckles and Logan tags in. Bron then presses Ford over his head and he drops him into a European uppercut by Logan for a near fall. Logan then gets a near fall. Logan then cinches in a reverse chin lock.
